page_title: ACM 1-1 ROM | AC Milan v AS Roma 29/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
90+3' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90+2' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
88' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
87' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) commits a rough foul. Michael Fabbri stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
86' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Morata will be replaced by Francesco Camarda (AC Milan).
86' Substitution. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) replaces Artem Dovbyk.
86' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the right post is saved by Mike Maignan.
84' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
84' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
83' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) for a tough tackle.
80' Great play by Tammy Abraham releases Emerson Royal (AC Milan) who decides to shoot from distance, but he balloons it high over the bar.
79' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) replaces Alexis Saelemaekers.
78' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) produces a stunning solo run from the middle of the pitch, all the way to the penalty area. He unleashes a decent strike which goes narrowly wide of the right post.
76' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
75' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
74' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. AC Milan earn a free kick.
74' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
71' Michael Fabbri shows the yellow card to Zeki Celik (AS Roma) for a heavy challenge.
71' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
70' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
69' High and wide! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
69' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and it's Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
67' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Fabbri didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
67' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
65' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar makes a decent save to stop the effort.
64' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
62' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) is substituted due to injury. Paulo Fonseca gives a chance to Tammy Abraham.
60' The current number of shots on goal is 6:4.
58' The injury to Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
57' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.

56' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Mile Svilar thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
56' The ball breaks to Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
55' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

55' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
54' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
53' AC Milan can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
52' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
52' The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.
51' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.

49' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) is replaced by Ismael Bennacer.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Lorenzo Pellegrini and Manu Kone (AS Roma) is off.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a half-time substitution. Zeki Celik comes on in place of Mats Hummels (AS Roma).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) was probably a bit loose with his words to Michael Fabbri, who decides to show him a yellow.
43' Paulo Fonseca almost immediately gets a second yellow card from referee Michael Fabbri and will have to vacate the bench!
43' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Fabbri ignores the protests.
41' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Referee Michael Fabbri halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Paulo Fonseca, then shows him a yellow.
40' A cross from a corner kick by AS Roma is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
38' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) commits a foul and Michael Fabbri immediately signals a free kick.
37' Handball by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
36' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
35' Flag goes up against Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
33' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
32' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Mile Svilar.
29' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
27' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
26' One of the AC Milan players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.

23' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Artem Dovbyk. The score is now 1:1.

21' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Mile Svilar was alert and the score remains the same.
18' The ball finds it way to Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the left post.

16' 1 - 0 What a goal! Youssouf Fofana plays it to Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Mile Svilar into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
14' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
13' Today's referee Michael Fabbri rightly decides to book Mats Hummels (AS Roma) for his harsh tackle.
13' Manu Kone (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
11' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
10' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
9' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.
7' Mats Hummels (AS Roma) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the left post, but Mike Maignan is alert and denies him.
5' Mile Svilar blocks Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan)'s effort from the edge of the box.
5' AC Milan are awarded a free kick.
4' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Manu Kone (AS Roma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
4' The keeper makes a simple save after Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
2' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
1' The first half has started.
AS Roma will kick-off.
